tree:2.help: Centre Tree: adjusts view settings so that the tree's core is at the centre of the working area.

tree:3.help: Static Redraw: refreshes the tree and redraws it with the preset layout.

tree:4.help: Original Tree: reloads the page and restores the tree to the same state and layout it had when it was initially loaded. It will ask for confirmation before leaving the page. Caution : this function will cause the loss of all changes you made to the tree.

map:0.help: Join by coordinates/by metadata: The toggle allows you to aggregate points on the map based on the geographical proximity of the provided coordinates or based on the values of the loaded metadata. In the first case, you can define a numerical value for delta , which determines the degree of aggregation.

map:4.help: Minimum/Maximum marker radius: With these two fields, you can adjust the size of the points on the map by defining a minimum and a maximum radius. The initial size is relative to the number of nodes located at the same geographical coordinates.

map:5.help: Minimum/Maximum marker radius: With these two fields, you can adjust the size of the points on the map by defining a minimum and a maximum radius. The initial size is relative to the number of nodes located at the same geographical coordinates.

map:11.help: Pie Chart mode/Heatmap mode: This toggle allows you to change the visualization mode of the points on the map. With the first option (selected by default), the points will be displayed with pie charts based on the categories of the tree nodes, while with the second option, a blur effect is applied to the nodes.

settings/node-style:0.help: Colour by: from the dropdown menu of this section it's possible to choose the fill-in colour of the nodes according to metadata.

settings/node-style:2.help: Show Labels: the switch will allow to choose whether to show the node labels or hide them. You can choose which label to show from the dropdown menu just below.

settings/node-style:3.help: Show Labels: the switch will allow to choose whether to show the node labels or hide them. You can choose which label to show from the dropdown menu just below.

settings/node-style:5.help: Font Size: the font size for the labels can be chosen either by dragging the slider or by specifying a size in the box.

settings/node-style:6.help: Highlight Label: use the text box to provide a search term for the labels to highlight the corresponding nodes. Supports Regular Expressions.

settings/node-style:8.help: Individual segments: use the switch to turn each node into a pie chart showing the breakdown of the members contained in it. The breakdown is based on the category used for the Colour by settings.

settings/node-size:1.help: Node Size (%): the overall node size can be increased or decreased through this option, either by using the slider or through the box.

settings/node-size:3.help: Kurtosis (%): the area of the nodes is correlated with the members inside them by default. Using this section's slider or box, the node's size can be increased or decreased based on the distribution's kurtosis of the nodes. By increasing this value, you raise the percentage by which the node size grows per member in the node, thus nodes with a larger number of members will have a larger area and will stick out more.

settings/branch-style:0.help: Show Labels: this option will allow you to choose whether to show the branch labels or hide them.

settings/branch-style:2.help: Font Size: this option allows you to choose the font size for the labels using the slider or the provided box.

settings/branch-style:5.help: Scaling (%): this option allows to increase or decrease the overall branches' lenght, by using the slider or by specifying a value in the box below it.

settings/branch-style:7.help: Collapse Branches: use the slider or enter a value in the box to collapse all branches shorter than the specified lenght. Nodes falling in that interval will be merged together. Branch lenght values are scaled to the branch lenghts defined in the original tree data.

settings/branch-style:9.help: Log Scale: by checking the box, all lenghts of all branches will be scaled logarithmically.

settings/branch-cutoffs:1.help: Display: show long branches as normal (default).

settings/rendering:0.help: Static: the tree layout is calculated when the tree is generated and remains static (but interactive); relative branch lenght and scaling (from the original tree data) will always be mantained as long as the Real Branch Lenght option is checked.

path: Unreal branch length / Real branch length

settings/node-shape:geometry.help: Geometry: circle, square, triangle, hexagon or octagon. Every shape keeps the area of the circle, so the node size still reflects the number of members.

settings/node-shape:border.help: Border: normal, double, dashed, dotted, or a decoration around the node: crown, gear, rounded gear, spikes, wavy crown.

settings/node-shape:select.help: Select by style: the round button at the top right of each cell selects the nodes with that shape or border; click it again to deselect them.

settings/node-shape:reset.help: Reset shapes and borders: brings all the nodes back to circle and normal border, after a confirmation.
